title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Paying Approved Settlements and Closing Decided Claims
content:
Under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims`, a claim that has been decided no longer stays open on its cover, and an approved settlement is then paid out. This page sets out both matters.

## Closing a decided claim

A decision on a claim, approving its settlement or rejecting it, brings the open claim on the cover to a close. Where the approved settlement is 0.00, the claim is closed with no payment entry at all.

## Paying an approved settlement

1. The claimant receives the settlement in full, at the amount approved, within the tier's payment period counted in calendar days from approval. The payment refers to the approval entry it pays.
2. The desk never pays a settlement in instalments.
3. Payment of a settlement requires the cover to show one of two statuses: claim open, or claim closed.
4. An approved claim is paid a single time.
5. Where the tier withholds settlements while premium is unpaid, the settlement is approved even though the cover still shows unpaid premium, but it is paid only when the unpaid premium on the cover stands at 0.00.

| Tier | Payment period after approval (calendar days) | Settlement withheld while premium is unpaid |
|---|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 30 | no |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 30 | yes |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 21 | yes |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 14 | yes |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 10 | yes |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 7 | yes |

## Truth table for unpaid premium (tiers that withhold)

| Unpaid premium on the cover | Approval of the settlement | Payment of the settlement |
|---|---|---|
| above 0.00 | proceeds | held back |
| 0.00 | proceeds | may be made, within the payment period |

Under `AHL Standard Carrier Liability`, which does not withhold, unpaid premium has no bearing on payment.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A settlement of 6400.00 USD is approved under `AHL CargoCare Plus` on a cover whose unpaid premium stands at 0.00. It is paid as one payment of 6400.00 within 14 calendar days of approval, and it is never paid a second time.
